title: On the Limits of Biased Derivative Information for Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization
summary: We consider the problem of finding $δ$-stationary points for $δ> 0$, i.e., $x \in \mathbb{R}^d$ such that $||\nabla F(x)|| \le δ$, for smooth, non-convex objectives, where the derivative oracles are not only stochastic but also biased. In the first-order setting, we provide tight lower bounds for finding an $O((ε+ B^2)^{1/2})$-stationary point, for $ε> 0$ and where $B$ is a bound on the gradient bias, matching the upper bounds of Ajalloeian and Stich (2020).
